content.text:
The grey descriptive text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't open the page in a browser to check how it looks.

I added one rule at the top of the Home section in `site/css/pages.css`. It only applies under `.page-home`, so other pages keep the original grey. It covers:
- the hero lede under the main heading,
- the paragraphs in cards (the featured Aurora Lamp blurb, the "Why Acme" items, the newsletter text),
- the stat labels,
- the `.muted` form note.

I left the footer and its links at the original grey, since they aren't text under headings. If you want them darker too, I can add them.

STATUS: DONE
